method: Author actually opened all six paired original source/current Blender model rows for every changed subject. Journal binds GLB, source, six actual renders and sheet SHA. Final saved native scenes separately reopened read-only for complete physical mesh floor checks; actual imported GLB requirement tests recompute direct surfaces, true eye apertures, palms and rider/wing volumes with negative regression variants.
scope: Current 0.3.3 user requests: compact direct humanlike head/body seat with no exposed neck, retained head-cover protection, jointed horse details, greatsword both hands, curved royal hair, rider legs before wing roots, larger Dragonrider wings, all crossbows rear trigger/front support, fitted Royal clothing, single hollow Paladin/Archangel helmet, integrated nonhuman Nature body. Source equipment/identity/orientation and visible clipping checked only within these changed assemblies.
explicitUserDesignOverrides: All humanlike heads directly on upper clothing/body supersede former exposed neck proportions, including enemy riders; true animal necks preserved.
Curved layered royal hair inspired by approved Claire supersedes earlier sparse straight hair.
Dragonrider larger wings and whole rider legs ahead of roots, contrasting navy/ivory armor supersede source purple rider armor.
Royal Ranger crossbow supersedes source bow; King Ranger Guard shield stays on back per prior explicit option.
Nature Spirit is livingwood/leaf body with integrated nonhuman face; historical PNG human flesh/standalone head superseded.
Paladin/Archangel share one actual integrated hollow helmet rather than intersecting oval and visor stacks.
limitations: Concept PNGs provide no physical ruler dimensions or camera calibration; absolute scale/hidden depth are author estimates.
This finite scoped review does not certify 1% dimensions or full silhouette IoU/facet identity.
Unchanged12 subjects do not claim new source/model viewing; only exact current bytes and eligible prior v3 record inheritance.
Animated effects and production .704 battlefield pose/ray audit are performed separately by independent runtime/root owner.
